security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: File manager with a real editor and terminal
bundle.longDescription: Tuwuh is a desktop file manager with categorised icons, multiple views, a Monaco editor pane for code files, a real terminal, and configurable AI providers whose keys are held in the OS keyring.
